set.prevailing_wage_basis: Not triggered for this program. California Labor Code 1720(c)(5)(C) states that, unless otherwise required by a public funding program, rehabilitation of privately owned residential projects is not public works where assistance is provided to a household for the rehabilitation of a single-family home (https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720). The 2024-2028 PLHA Formula Guidelines contain no prevailing wage requirement (searched, no match). For the CDBG-funded portion, 42 U.S.C. 5310(a) applies Davis-Bacon to rehabilitation of residential property only if it contains 8 or more units, so single-family owner-occupied rehab is exempt (https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/42/5310).
set.audit_note: Tier 3: prevailing wage set false based on Labor Code 1720(c)(5)(C) single-family rehab exemption, absence of a PLHA guidelines requirement, and the 8-unit CDBG Davis-Bacon threshold in 42 U.S.C. 5310. Program page re-read 2026-11-08; up to $100,000 deferred loan and 120% AMI limits still shown.

reason: Single-family owner-occupied rehab is exempt under Labor Code 1720(c)(5)(C) and below the 8-unit CDBG Davis-Bacon threshold, and PLHA guidelines add no requirement.
